NEW EVENTS — ARMOR, WEAPONS AND HEIRLOOMS, ARM-46 to ARM-95 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing "Isola — Armor, Weapons, and Inherited Traditions" (events 01-45, shipped as ARMOR-01..45). Same style as yours: "NN. Title — one or two sentences", numbered 46-95.

ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the dash before its text
the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: An old hunting bow, too worn to hunt with, is fitted with a hollow gourd and plucked for music.

setup.text: An old hunting bow, too worn to hunt with, is fitted with a hollow gourd and plucked for music. Its owner, (name1), says it has never sounded so cheerful.
